# Twins Garage Doors

> Family-owned garage door company in Madison, Wisconsin, run by twin brothers.
> Repair, spring replacement, opener service, and new door installation.
> Rated 4.9 out of 5 from 699 Google reviews (verified 2026-07-20).

## Company

- Name: Twins Garage Doors
- Type: Local garage door repair and installation company, family owned and operated by twin brothers, not a franchise
- Founded: 2016
- Primary location: 2921 Landmark Pl #206, Madison, WI 53713
- Kentucky location: 3651 Aarons Run Rd, Mt Sterling, KY 40353
- Phone (main office): (608) 888-8785
- Website: https://twinsgaragedoors.com
- Hours: Open 24 hours (per Google Business Profile)
- Rating: 4.9 out of 5, 699 Google reviews (verified 2026-07-20)
- Licensed and insured

## Services

- Garage door repair (doors that will not open or close, off track, noisy, crooked)
- Garage door spring repair and replacement (torsion and extension)
- Garage door opener repair, installation, and replacement
- Garage door cable, roller, and hardware repair
- New garage door sales and installation (Clopay dealer)
- Garage door tune-up and maintenance plans
- Emergency garage door service

## Pricing (real ranges from completed jobs)

Pricing reviewed July 10, 2026, based on completed Twins Garage Doors jobs from
July 2025 through July 2026. These are historical planning ranges, not estimates,
offers, or guaranteed prices. Every project is inspected and priced individually.

- Service call and diagnostic: $49, waived when you complete a repair with Twins
  (current fee, confirmed 2026-07-20)
- Garage door repair: $400 to $1,050
- New opener installed: $900 to $1,450
- New garage door installed: $3,000 to $4,100
- New door and opener together: $4,400 to $7,250
- Repair jobs that included spring replacement: the middle 50 percent of total
  invoices ranged from $780 to $1,660 (total invoice, not a spring-only parts price)

## Service area

Wisconsin: Madison, Milwaukee, Middleton, Fitchburg, Sun Prairie, Verona, Waunakee,
DeForest, Cottage Grove, McFarland, Monona, Oregon, Deerfield, Cross Plains,
Belleville, Edgerton, Evansville, Janesville, Milton, Fort Atkinson, Marshall,
Prairie du Sac, Stoughton, Mount Horeb, Shorewood Hills, Spring Green.

Kentucky: Lexington and the surrounding area.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Twins Garage Doors is an authorized Clopay dealer.
- Safety: garage door springs are under high tension and should be handled by
  trained technicians. Do not attempt spring replacement without training.
- The price ranges above are historical planning ranges from completed jobs, not
  quotes. An on-site inspection produces the actual price, given before work starts.
